name: @w6w-apps/canva
description: Create and manage Canva designs, folders, assets and brand templates over the Canva Connect API.

w6w.longDescription:
Canva Connect is the OAuth-gated REST API behind Canva's design platform. This app covers its genuinely headless-callable core: create and list designs, read a design's pages/export-formats/autofill dataset, manage Projects folders and their contents, upload and manage image/video assets, run the asynchronous export and autofill jobs (and poll them to completion), and list/read brand templates.

Canva scopes access tightly per action — every action here declares the exact scope it needs, and several endpoints (asset upload, design export, design autofill) are asynchronous: a `create-*` action starts a job and a paired `get-*` action polls it, mirroring the vendor's own documented workflow rather than blocking on completion.

Deliberately left out: Comments, Analytics, Design imports, Merges, Resizes and Webhooks. Comments/Analytics/Merges/Resizes are all straightforward extensions of the same job/REST shapes used here, just not verified against live traffic for this first pass; Design imports duplicates the asset-upload job shape for a different resource; Webhooks need a receiving endpoint this host doesn't expose per-app. See the README for exactly what was verified and why each of these was left out rather than guessed at.
